subject.title: feat: add signed marketplace feed config

question: Should OpenClaw accept the current-head staged signed marketplace feed config before signed refresh enforcement is merged?
rationale: The patch is coherent and tested, but it exposes supply-chain trust configuration and a selected runtime path that fails closed until a follow-up PR consumes signed envelopes.

options.title: Accept staged config slice
options.body: Merge after exact-head checks if maintainers are comfortable owning the temporary fail-closed signed-profile behavior until enforcement follows.

options.title: Land with refresh enforcement
options.body: Hold this PR until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98338 can land with it so accepted signed config has a working consumer immediately.

options.title: Pause the trust stack
options.body: Keep the stack open but unmerged until the broader marketplace feed trust direction is settled.

recommendation.title: Accept staged config slice
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head checks if maintainers are comfortable owning the temporary fail-closed signed-profile behavior until enforcement follows.
